items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: John is a good friend of mine. Through him, I met him with Benny Goodman in 1957... He recommended me to everybody... he was a good friend you know.

ctx.x: No, see John was a great writer and he was a great trumpet player. Bill Potts. Have you heard of Bill Potts?
